title: Onboarding
about: Consent, a short background form, the guidelines and a 5-question check.

title: Kinship words
about: Give the words your language uses for 150 relatives.

title: Resolve disagreements
about: Choose the right word where the two annotators differ.

title: Question wording
about: Correct or approve question templates and name lists.

title: Pilot item check
about: Check every pilot question: natural, correct, one answer.

title: Full-set check
about: Check a sample of the final questions.

title: Answer questions
about: Answer questions yourself, without seeing the answers.

title: Check model answers
about: Mark model answers correct, wrong or invalid.
